title: The shells heaped in the cold stone mortar
html_source: Stephen runs his hand over Mr. Deasy’s sea shell collection that is set in mortar. In the next chapter (Proteus), Stephen calls them “sea money” and thinks that Mr. Deasy “kens them” or knows them all.
